final: SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanfeatures sf2 JOIN sites s2 ON sf2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE sf2.traitcount >= 489) AS fraction FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
